arguments.sql:
WITH quota_years AS (
    SELECT BusinessEntityID, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS quota_year,
           COUNT(*) AS quota_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT SalesQuota) AS distinct_quotas
    FROM main.SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate)
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quota_years) AS salesperson_quota_years,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quota_years WHERE quota_entries > 1) AS years_with_multiple_entries,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quota_years WHERE distinct_quotas > 1) AS years_with_multiple_quota_amounts,
    COUNT(*) AS assigned_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN h.subtotal <> h.totaldue THEN 1 END) AS assigned_orders_with_different_amounts
FROM main.salesorderheader AS h
JOIN main.salesperson AS s ON s.businessentityid = h.salespersonid
